tasks.category: Leadership Level 1, Follower (Provide Action)
tasks.verbatim_text: Followers have several responsibilities: to become competent in basic job skills, take initiative, learn from others, ask questions, and develop communications skills.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Ensure individual readiness.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Secure required software (e.g., ArcGIS Pro) and suggested hardware, including laptop, mouse, power strip, mobile device, external monitor, and mobile internet hotspot.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Ensure appropriate account credentials.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Gather critical information pertinent to the assignment.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Travel to and check in at assignment.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain initial briefing from Situation Unit Leader (SITL) or other incident supervisor.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain information for ordering or securing equipment and supplies (e.g., plotter, paper, ink, mobile devices).

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Obtain briefing from previous shift/assignment position as necessary.

tasks.category: Prepare and Mobilize
tasks.verbatim_text: Support a minimum of one Type 1 or Type 2 wildfire incident on- site.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Copy the NWCG Standards for Geospatial Operations, PMS 936 incident directory to hard drive, network attached storage (NAS), or Microsoft SharePoint/OneDrive, and rename files and folders for incident.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Fully populate the NWCG Standards for Geospatial Operations, PMS 936 File Namer with required data elements.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Configure the ArcGIS Pro Project Template for the incident and set an appropriate coordinate system.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Populate the base_data folder with data relevant to fire area including, but not limited to, 24K topographic map and aerial imagery.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create Edit Project using the ArcGIS Pro Project Template and populate the DynamicTextUpdate table.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create Offline Copy of National Incident Feature Service (NIFS).

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Repair Event Layers to Offline Copy.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Configure Feature Templates for all Event Layers and save as a group layer file.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Set up the Incident Web Map using current National Interagency Fire Center ArcGIS Online Organization (NIFC Org) web map templates and share with the appropriate Mobile Edit group.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Process, convert, and import incoming data from sources outside the National Incident Feature Service (NIFS) and work with the Situation Unit Leader (SITL) or other incident supervisor to approve new data.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Store incident data per NWCG Standards for Geospatial Operations, PMS 936 file structure and naming conventions.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Sync Offline Copy before and after each edit session.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Edit Event Polygon, Event Line, and Event Point features and at tributes; calculate polygon acres, line length, and point latitude and longitude.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Calculate acres burned by ownership/jurisdiction/protection.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Calculate line lengths by feature category.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Calculate percent containment.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Populate the Progression Geodatabase (GDB).

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Back up the Offline Copy of National Incident Feature Service (NIFS).

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Replace the Master Incident Geodatabase (GDB).

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a Master Project.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Use dynamic text to populate map elements from the DynamicTextTable and Map View metadata.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Use definition queries to display only the Event Features appropriate for the intended map audience.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a single-page Incident Action Plan (IAP) or Operations Map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a multi-page map using a Map Series that includes an index page or vicinity map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Demonstrate the use of label lines for Division and Branch labeling in a Map Series.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a Briefing Map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a Transportation Map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create an Ownership Map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a Progression Map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create an Air Operations Map that includes a coordinate point table.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a Public Information Map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a Suppression Repair Map.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Create a specialized map (e.g., areas of special concern, ev acuation, Facilities, Strategic Operations, Structure Triage, Accountable Property).

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Export, name, and file geospatial portable document format (PDF) maps in the products folder.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Effectively utilize large format plotters (e.g., printing maps and multi-panel maps, maintenance, troubleshooting).

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Back up map projects in the backups folder.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Post maps to the appropriate file sharing locations (e.g., National Interagency Fire Center [NIFC] File Share, FireNet) and create Quick Response (QR) codes to link to the appropriate folder for incident use.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Back up the incident directory to a secondary physical drive.

tasks.category: Perform Geographic Information System Specialist-Specific Duties
tasks.verbatim_text: Download and back up external incident data sources, hosted feature services, and data collection forms.

tasks.category: Communicate and Coordinate
tasks.verbatim_text: Maintain awareness of changing responsibilities and expectations.

tasks.category: Communicate and Coordinate
tasks.verbatim_text: Communicate to the Situation Unit Leader (SITL) or other in cident supervisor when map and task requests are made outside the Incident Command System (ICS) chain of command.

tasks.category: Communicate and Coordinate
tasks.verbatim_text: Establish and maintain positive interpersonal and interagency working relationships.

tasks.category: Communicate and Coordinate
tasks.verbatim_text: Demonstrate critical thinking and decision-making skills.

tasks.category: Communicate and Coordinate
tasks.verbatim_text: Communicate and exchange technical information with incident personnel inside and outside the Situation Unit.

tasks.category: Communicate and Coordinate
tasks.verbatim_text: Conduct and/or participate in After Action Reviews (AARs).

tasks.category: Document
tasks.verbatim_text: Complete all administrative tasks and documentation in an accurate and timely manner.

tasks.category: Document
tasks.verbatim_text: Prepare maps and other documents for the incident do cumentation package as required by the Document Unit Leader (DOCL).

tasks.category: Document
tasks.verbatim_text: Provide inputs to the GISS section of team transition plan for use by the incoming team.

tasks.category: Demobilization
tasks.verbatim_text: Transfer online content to the incoming team or local unit (e.g., non-National Incident Feature Service [NIFS] data embedded in w eb maps/applications, incident-specific web maps/applications, hosted feature services, FireNet content, other incident data or products not contained in the incident directory structure).

tasks.category: Demobilization
tasks.verbatim_text: Prepare for and implement demobilization.
